scope: Authenticated frozen protocol/source and prior event evidence
Independent scalar features from hash-pinned prepared DFLS data
Public TXE execution reconstruction and fee arithmetic for all prior and additional event rows
Structure horizon and same-event h5 pairing
All group, segment, matching, bootstrap, opportunity-loss denominators
Independent dynamic-programming optimum versus greedy frequency upper bound
findings: Frequency bound is mathematical maximum for recorded fixed event intervals with same-day turnover allowed; any feasible subset is bounded above
Matching uses contemporaneous known features but is descriptive and reuses controls; not a forward predictor or causal identification
Structure exit horizon is a maximum decision horizon; unfilled market exits may occur later under retry contract
limitations: Not independent out-of-sample validation; repeated development-pool exposure
Audit shares public TXE engine and prepared-data loader, not independently validated engine internals
No supplier historical publication-clock or revised-price PIT proof
Independent overlapping events do not form an account; sums are not portfolio PnL
Frequency upper bound only rules out these frozen entries/exits, not every alternative price-action strategy
No new strategy qualification, continuous account or search
